body:
Give a design run one command that shows the whole design format. That means every element type, its required and optional properties, the values each property allows, and a minimal valid example of each, plus the shape of each proposal operation (D-241 point 2). The design agent's report said this lookup was most of its work. Today the format can only be learned by reading the Rust constants and test JSON.

## Done when

- A design run can call the command, and the run's commands and help list it.
- What it prints comes from the same table the rules check against (`design.ELEMENT_TYPES` and its `ElementType` entries), not from a hand-written copy. A test shows every listed example passes `design.validate`.
- Spec 15's design run paragraph names it.

## Suggested (cursory, not prescriptive)

- A name like `design schema`, plus a short line in the Designer brief saying it exists.
title: design: list the element format
